reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-09-29. The GUSD product page (total subscription 202.6 million GUSD, about $202.3 million, 3.50% APR) describes a principal-protected product backed by tokenized treasury bills and stablecoins with returns from Gate ecosystem revenue, Treasury RWAs, and stablecoin-backed yield assets; the GUSD hub page adds that holdings are reinforced with USDC reserves in U.S. dollars and short-term Treasuries. Every statement is category-level. The help article of 2025-08-29 commits to clear reserve audit reports and proof of funds from partner custodial banks on the product page, but no report, instrument schedule, allocation weight, named reserve vehicle, or custodian list is published on any reviewed surface. Gate's monthly exchange proof of reserves (latest reviewed snapshots: July 27, 2026 published August 3; August 19, 2026 announced August 24) books GUSD as a user asset whose platform reserves are held in the same tokens, which evidences custody of customer GUSD tokens rather than the assets backing issued GUSD. Subscription inputs USDT, USDC, and USD1 are minting inputs, and exchange custody balances are not reserve weights. The single undisclosed envelope is therefore retained with no defensible split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gate GUSD product, hub, and help disclosures plus Gate exchange proof-of-reserves announcements, all reviewed 2026-09-29; Gate publishes no product-level reserve composition
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gate does not publish current backing weights, instrument identities, reserve-vehicle terms, custody providers, legal segregation, or a product-specific reconciliation of issued GUSD to backing assets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Gate does not identify the GUSD legal reserve vehicle, backing-asset custody providers, provider shares, segregation model, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms. The 2025-08-29 help article commits to reserve audit reports and partner-custodial-bank proof of funds on the product page, but no such document is published there as of 2026-09-29. Gate's exchange proof-of-reserves materials concern customer-asset custody and do not fill those product-specific gaps.
